description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Vizier of Many Faces.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vizier of Many Faces by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.name: Vizier of Many Faces
uses.cardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater
